feeds.title: 药物 · 临床试验
feeds.term: (lecanemab OR donanemab OR "anti-amyloid" OR "tau-targeting" OR trontinemab) AND ("clinical trial"[Publication Type] OR phase OR efficacy)

feeds.title: 机制 · 基础研究
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.title: 诊断 · 生物标志物
feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.title: 预防 · 生活方式
feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Tau-targeting pharmacological strategies in neurodegenerative disease.
drug.zh: 靶向病理tau而非全面降低，是tau蛋白病治疗策略的关键转向。

drug.title: Comparison of double-blind and open-label decline rates in lecanemab and donanemab trials in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 双盲与开放标签阶段斜率差异提示，仑卡奈单抗和多奈单抗的长期疗效或被高估。

drug.title: Volume change with gantenerumab: Impact of amyloid-related imaging abnormalities and amyloid removal.
drug.zh: gantenerumab致脑实质容积减少主要源于淀粉样蛋白清除，而非ARIA。

drug.title: Real-world implementation of lecanemab in Korean patients at a tertiary memory clinic: Safety, ARIA risk, and early treatment patterns.
drug.zh: 韩国真实世界数据证实仑卡奈单抗安全性可控，ARIA发生率低，早期认知获益显著。

drug.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 血浆p-tau217无法可靠监测多奈单抗治疗后的淀粉样蛋白清除。

drug.title: A randomized phase 1b/2 trial of ABBV-916 in adults with early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: ABBV-916显著降低早期AD患者脑内淀粉样蛋白，但高剂量安全性受限，剂量调整后疗效与风险需权衡。

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者使用仑卡奈单抗12个月CDR-SB无显著变化，ARIA发生率7.87%，停药主因经济负担。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非遗忘型不典型阿尔茨海默病多数符合抗淀粉样蛋白治疗入组标准。

mech.title: Pathological depositions in human disease: converging mechanisms in atherosclerosis, Alzheimer's disease, and related disorders.
mech.zh: 动脉粥样硬化与阿尔茨海默病共享脂质与蛋白沉积的病理机制，apoA-I功能异常是关键交汇点。

mech.title: Anatomy of a Setback: A Taxonomy of Clinical Trial Failures in Alzheimer's Disease and Strategic Lessons for the Future.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默病临床试验失败可归为五类，靶点、时机、患者、靶点占有及终点错误是核心教训。

mech.title: Arachnoid granulation morphologies and β-amyloid and tau pathology in older adults.
mech.zh: 高龄者蛛网膜颗粒数量与阿尔茨海默病病理负担呈负相关。

mech.title: Optimized plasma p-tau217 and p-tau217/Aβ42 cutoffs enhance detection of pre-clinical Alzheimer's disease across diverse participants.
mech.zh: 优化p-tau217及p-tau217/Aβ42阈值可跨种族提升临床前阿尔茨海默病检出。

mech.title: Group-level versus individualized approaches for capturing tau PET changes and clinical progression in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 个体化tau PET量化方法更能捕捉异质性，优于传统组水平分析。

mech.title: When myelin breaks, tau aggregates - a new perspective on Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 髓鞘损伤驱动tau聚集，揭示少突胶质细胞在阿尔茨海默病中的新机制。

mech.title: Prospective study on physical activity and Alzheimer's disease-related biomarkers.
mech.zh: 中年运动量越大，67岁时血浆NfL和GFAP水平越低。

mech.title: Four-year evolution of the retinal microvasculature in an APOE ε4/ε4 cognitively normal individual.
mech.zh: APOE ε4纯合认知正常者视网膜微血管加速丢失或早于脑淀粉样沉积。

dx.title: Language-enhanced generative modeling for amyloid PET synthesis from MRI and blood biomarkers.
dx.zh: 语言增强生成模型可仅凭MRI和血液指标合成高保真Aβ-PET，辅助阿尔茨海默病诊断。

dx.title: Association of total and brain-derived Alzheimer's disease plasma biomarkers with brain amyloid deposition in a community-based sample.
dx.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health
dx.zh: 社区样本中脑源性p-tau217等血浆标志物可反映脑内淀粉样沉积，且受肾功能影响。

dx.title: Determining the metabolic profile measured using ultra-high pressure liquid chromatography associated with Beta Amyloid burden in the brain in individuals with mild cognitive impairment.
dx.zh: UPLC代谢谱可反映MCI患者脑内β-淀粉样蛋白负荷，或为AD早期生物标志物。

dx.title: Novel Plasma Proteins Associated With Alzheimer's Disease Risk in APOE ε4 Carriers and Non-carriers.
dx.zh: APOE ε4携带者与非携带者血浆蛋白关联阿尔茨海默病风险显著不同。

dx.title: A leakage-controlled multi-compartment benchmark of fluid biomarkers for predicting mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease conversion: plasma, CSF, and high-plex omics in a single cohort.
dx.zh: 血浆与脑脊液及高复合组学预测MCI转AD效能相当，且成本更低。

dx.title: Regional Cerebrospinal Fluid Motility as a Key Determinant of Soluble Amyloid-β Levels and Kinetics.
dx.zh: 脑脊液区域运动力决定可溶性Aβ水平与清除动力学，或为AD关键机制。

dx.title: Antemortem α-Synuclein levels from neuron-derived extracellular vesicles identify Lewy Body pathology in Parkinson's Disease and Alzheimer Disease.
dx.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health
dx.zh: 神经元来源细胞外囊泡α-突触核蛋白水平可无创识别帕金森病及阿尔茨海默病中的路易体病理。

dx.title: Altered T1w/T2w-FLAIR Ratio in White Matter Hyperintensities as an Indicator of Structural Integrity Loss: Association with Alzheimer's Disease and Vascular Dementia.
dx.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health
dx.zh: 白质高信号内T1w/T2w-FLAIR比值下降可区分阿尔茨海默病与血管性痴呆的病理机制。

prev.title: Exosome-derived biomarkers as non-invasive tools in stroke, Parkinson's disease, and Alzheimer's disease.
prev.zh: 外泌体蛋白及小非编码RNA可作为卒中、帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病的无创生物标志物。

prev.title: Cognitive impairment and hospital admission risk among community-dwelling adults in the MAUCO cohort.
prev.zh: 社区中老年人筛查性认知障碍显著增加住院及再入院风险。

prev.title: Correction: Comorbidity sequence, sex, and APOE-genotype forecast Alzheimer's disease diagnosis.
prev.zh: 更正论文：共病序列、性别与APOE基因型可预测阿尔茨海默病诊断。

prev.title: Estimated pulse wave velocity, dementia risk, and vascular aging phenotypes: a post-hoc analysis of the SPRINT-MIND trial in the United States.
prev.zh: ePWV可识别痴呆高危阈值，并区分不同血管老化表型。

prev.title: The Association between Saccadic Eye Movement Parameters and Mild Cognitive Impairment: The Nagahama Study.
prev.zh: 扫视眼动参数可精准识别轻度认知障碍，有望成为便捷筛查新工具。

prev.title: Randomized metformin and cognitive outcomes in the Diabetes Prevention Program Outcomes Study.
prev.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health
prev.zh: 二甲双胍长期干预不改变糖尿病前期人群认知衰退风险。

prev.title: Serum sodium, tonicity, and risk of dementia in cohort and healthcare populations.
prev.zh: 血清钠高于141 mmol/L即与痴呆风险升高相关，提示慢性轻度脱水或为可干预的痴呆预警指标。

prev.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
prev.zh: 更年期失眠是可干预的痴呆风险节点，靶向脑内雌激素合成或可增强认知韧性。

intro.title: Menopausal insomnia as a modifiable node of dementia risk: Mechanistic insights and intervention strategies.
intro.zh: 更年期睡不好，可能悄悄增加以后得老年痴呆的风险，但睡好了就能帮大脑“防老”，这篇讲的就是怎么抓住这个关键期。

intro.title: Advances in the clinical application of mesenchymal stem cells for neurological disorders.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是用干细胞治疗老年痴呆等脑部疾病，目前看安全可行，但效果还在验证中。

intro.title: Gantenerumab for Early Alzheimer's Disease: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
intro.zh: 这药治早期老年痴呆效果还不确定，但能帮您和家人了解新疗法到底靠不靠谱，别花冤枉钱。

intro.title: Pharmacological Effects and Molecular Mechanisms of Lignans in the Treatment of Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是木头里的天然成分（木脂素）能多管齐下延缓老年痴呆，对咱普通人来说，就是将来可能靠吃这些成分来防病或减缓病情。

intro.title: Oxidative Stress in Alzheimer's Disease: Can Dietary Interventions Provide Neuroprotection?
intro.zh: 人老了脑子生病，可能跟吃的东西有关，调整饮食或许能帮着防一防、拖一拖。

intro.title: Blood-Based Biomarkers for Alzheimer Disease in Primary Care: The Gap Between Biology and Clinical Utility.
intro.zh: 查血就能提前看出老年痴呆风险，但光靠验血还不够，得先想清楚怎么用才不白花钱。

intro.title: Revisiting TREM2: from multi-omics signaling networks to clinical translation.
intro.zh: 这篇文章讲的是身体里一种叫TREM2的“免疫开关”如何影响大脑和肿瘤，看懂它，能帮你理解未来治痴呆和癌症的新药方向。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”会让人记性变差、动作变慢，看懂它就能明白为啥老人容易得痴呆，提前注意保养脑子。
